newsitem.title: ROMANIA: Romania average one-week rate down to 50 pct.
newsitem.headline: Romania average one-week rate down to 50 pct.

text.p: The National Bank of Romania (BNR) said on Friday the average accepted rate for its one-week refinancing funds slipped three percentage points to 50 percent at this week's auction.
On Thursday, the BNR cut its minimum permitted rate on one-week funds to 50 percent from last week's 53 percent.
The BNR's offer of 940 billion lei, up from a previous 700 billion lei, was matched by five commercial banks that entered bids at prices equalling the minimum permitted rate.
